title: AI-Powered Claims Validation
subtitle: Powered by SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP)

left_persona.name: Maya
left_persona.caption: Determine whether the claim is valid by reconciling payment, claim details, shipment evidence, delivery records, and financial impact.

right_persona.name: Jordan
right_persona.caption: Provides the reviewer with the decisive evidence and a clear recommended next step.

challenge: As an AR claims specialist, I need to turn a customer deduction into a defensible decision. Today, claim details can be buried in remittance advice, payment records, invoices, and shipping documents. Manually reconciling these sources takes time, delays cross-functional review, and can lead to inconsistent outcomes.
solution: The Claims Validation Agent brings claim and supporting-document context into one review workspace. It generates an evidence-based assessment that helps the reviewer approve, reject, or investigate with confidence.
benefits: Reduce manual reconciliation across claim, invoice reference, BOL, and POD evidence.
Improve confidence with explicit validation of quantities, locations, delivery exceptions, and signatures.
Create a defensible record with supporting documents, structured analysis results, and reviewer actions.
